title: Bulk discount is not applied at exactly 50 or 100 units
requirement: A customer reports that an invoice line of exactly 50 units got no bulk discount. The pricing policy (documented in invoicekit/discounts.py) is that a line of at least 50 units gets 5% off and a line of at least 100 units gets 10% off. Find and fix the defect so that the policy holds at every quantity, including the exact thresholds, without changing any other behaviour.
